candidates.lead: The Australian tax calendar for 2026-27 runs from 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027 [[CALENDAR_YEAR]]. The 2025-26 individual tax return is due 31 October 2026 for self-lodgers [[RETURN_2026.selfLodgeDueDate]], which falls on a weekend, so the ATO accepts 2 November 2026 [[RETURN_DATES_2026.selfLodge]]; quarterly BAS and PAYG instalments are due 28 October, 28 February, 28 April and 28 July [[QUARTERS_2026_27]].

A tax week in Australia is one of the 52 weeks of the financial year, which for 2026-27 runs from 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027 [[CALENDAR_YEAR]]. Within that year the 2025-26 tax return is due 31 October 2026, accepted on 2 November 2026 as the next business day [[RETURN_DATES_2026.selfLodge]], or 15 May 2027 for most tax agent clients [[RETURN_2026]]; super is due within 7 business days of each payday.

Key tax dates for 2026-27 are set by the ATO: the income year runs 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027 [[CALENDAR_YEAR]], STP finalisation is due 14 July, quarterly BAS and PAYG instalments fall on the 28th of October, February, April and July [[QUARTERS_2026_27]], and the self-lodged 2025-26 return is due 31 October 2026 [[RETURN_2026.selfLodgeDueDate]]. A due date on a weekend moves to the next business day.
